-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies Homey API credentials and connectivity.

homey-get-user.name: homey-get-user
homey-get-user.description: Get authenticated user information from Homey

homey-list-devices.name: homey-list-devices
homey-list-devices.description: List all devices connected to Homey with their zone, class, capabilities, and availability status

homey-get-device.name: homey-get-device
homey-get-device.description: Get detailed information and current state of a specific Homey device by ID

homey-set-capability.name: homey-set-capability
homey-set-capability.description: Set a device capability value (e.g., turn on/off, set brightness, temperature). Use homey-list-devices to find device IDs and capabilities.

params.value: Value to set (boolean for onoff, number 0-1 for dim, number for temperature)

homey-list-flows.name: homey-list-flows
homey-list-flows.description: List all flows (automations) configured in Homey

homey-trigger-flow.name: homey-trigger-flow
homey-trigger-flow.description: Trigger (run) a Homey flow by its ID

homey-list-zones.name: homey-list-zones
homey-list-zones.description: List all zones (rooms/areas) configured in Homey

homey-get-system-info.name: homey-get-system-info
homey-get-system-info.description: Get Homey system information including firmware version, model, uptime, Wi-Fi status, and more

homey-list-notifications.name: homey-list-notifications
homey-list-notifications.description: List notifications from Homey (alerts, warnings, system messages)

homey-get-variables.name: homey-get-variables
homey-get-variables.description: List all logic variables configured in Homey. Logic variables are used in flows/automations for state tracking.

homey-set-variable.name: homey-set-variable
homey-set-variable.description: Set the value of a Homey logic variable by its ID. Use homey-get-variables to find variable IDs.

params.value: New value for the variable (string, number, or boolean — must match the variable type)

homey-list-apps.name: homey-list-apps
homey-list-apps.description: List all apps installed on Homey. Useful for diagnostics and checking which integrations are active.

homey-get-energy.name: homey-get-energy
homey-get-energy.description: Get live energy report from Homey including current power usage and generation across the home

params.zone: Optional zone ID to filter energy data for a specific zone

name: Homey
description: Homey smart home controller - Control devices, manage flows, and monitor your home via Athom Cloud API

changelog.notes: Initial release — control smart home devices, run automation flows, manage rooms and variables, and monitor live energy
